user.title: Cantabile setup
user.description:
Cantabile brings a retro hi-fi radio and cassette deck card to your dashboard. This wizard sets it up in a few steps:

1. **Speakers** – which of your media players the card plays on, and the default one.
2. **Music library** *(optional)* – your own music folder, e.g. a NAS share.
3. **Radio stations** *(optional)* – the most popular stations of your country on the preset buttons.
4. **TV** *(optional)* – TVs that show the track on screen (Cantabile TV).
5. **Voice** – starting music by voice through an AI conversation agent.
6. **Dashboard** – where the card goes: a new *Music* dashboard in the sidebar, an existing dashboard, or nowhere for now.

Nothing is lost if you skip a step: everything can be changed later on the card (⚙) or under **Configure → Setup wizard**.

speakers.title: Speakers
speakers.description:
Found {count} media players ({groups}). Tick the ones Cantabile should play on – speakers are ticked already, TVs and media servers aren't. The **default speaker** comes first on the card's speaker selector.

Names longer than 8 characters get a short name on the card; you can change it later on the card under ⚙ → Speakers.

data_description.speakers: Grouped by integration: Sonos, WiiM, LinkPlay, Google Cast, DLNA, Music Assistant, Squeezebox, other.
data_description.default_speaker: First on the selector; voice commands without a speaker name use it too.

speakers_none.title: No speakers yet
speakers_none.description:
Home Assistant has no media players yet, so there's nothing to play on. Add your speakers' integration first: [Settings → Devices & services]({integrations_url}) → **Add integration** → e.g. *Sonos*, *WiiM*, *LinkPlay*, *Google Cast*, *DLNA Digital Media Renderer*, *Music Assistant* or *Squeezebox*.

You can continue now and add the speakers later – on the card (⚙ → Speakers) or with **Configure → Setup wizard → Speakers**.

library.title: Music library (optional)
library.description:
Cantabile plays your own music from a folder in Home Assistant's media (the NAS tab: artist → album → tracks). Folders with music:

{found}

Pick one (or type a media-source path), or **leave it empty to skip**.

**Music on a NAS?** Add it first: [Settings → System → Storage]({storage_url}) → **Add network storage**, usage *Media*. It then appears in [Media]({media_url}) under *My media* – run this step again afterwards (Configure → Setup wizard → Music library).

data_description.media_folder: A media-source path, e.g. media-source://media_source/local/Music. Layout: artist / album / tracks.
data_description.hires_folder: Sonos plays at most 48 kHz: a subfolder of the music folder with 48 kHz copies of hi-res albums (folder / artist / album). Leave empty if you have none.
data_description.upload_folder: PHONE uploads are kept here, inside the music folder (needs write access).

radio.title: Radio stations (optional)
radio.description: The most popular stations in your country ({country}), from Radio Browser. The ticked ones go on the radio's preset buttons – at most {max}. Untick all to leave the buttons empty; the NET button finds thousands more any time, and ⚙ on the card adds or changes stations.

data_description.stations: Most popular first. MP3 / AAC streams are the safest on Sonos.

radio_offline.title: Radio stations (optional)
radio_offline.description: Radio Browser can't be reached right now (no internet?). Skip this step – the preset buttons stay empty, and you can fill them later on the card: tap an empty **+** button or **NET**, or use ⚙ → Stations.

tv.title: TV (optional)

data_description.tv_players: Each becomes a “TV · …” speaker on the card.

tv_none.title: TV (optional)

voice.title: Voice control
voice.description:
With an AI (LLM) conversation agent you can say *“Play Queen in the living room”* or *“Put on Radio Paradise”*. Conversation agents found:

{agents}

Home Assistant doesn't let one integration change another one's options, so turn Cantabile on in the agent yourself:
1. Open [Settings → Devices & services]({integrations_url}) and select the agent's integration (e.g. *Google Gemini*, *OpenAI*, *Anthropic*, *Ollama*).
2. Click **Configure** (⚙) next to the agent.
3. Under **Control Home Assistant**, tick **Cantabile** next to *Assist*.
4. Submit, then try it in Assist.

data_description.llm_api: Offers the Cantabile tool to LLM conversation agents. Turn it off if you don't use voice control.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Where should the Cantabile card go? It comes filled in with the speakers, stations and music folder chosen in the previous steps. Your dashboards are listed under [Settings → Dashboards]({dashboards_url}).

dashboard_none.title: Dashboard
dashboard_none.description: The card needs at least one speaker, so it isn't placed now. Add your speakers' integration ([Settings → Devices & services]({integrations_url})), then run **Configure → Setup wizard → Speakers** and **Dashboard** – or add the card yourself later (Edit dashboard → Add card → Cantabile).

dashboard_new.title: New dashboard
dashboard_new.description: A new dashboard with the card across the full width, shown in the sidebar for quick access.

dashboard_existing.title: Existing dashboard
dashboard_existing.description: Pick the dashboard and view. The card is added at the end of the view (in a sections view as a new section). Dashboards kept in YAML are listed too – for those you get the card snippet to paste yourself.

dashboard_yaml.title: YAML dashboard
dashboard_yaml.description:
This dashboard is managed in YAML, so Cantabile doesn't change it. Paste this card into the view yourself:

{yaml}

play.name: Play by name
play.description: Finds an artist, album, track, radio station or playlist by name and starts it on a Cantabile speaker. Returns what is playing and where.

query.name: What
query.description: Name of the artist, album, track, station or playlist.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: What the name refers to; automatic when unsure.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: Artist of the album or track, if known.

speaker.name: Speaker
speaker.description: Speaker name from the card, or “all” for every Sonos speaker together. Empty: the one playing now, otherwise the first.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Random order. On by default for an artist.

play_tracks.name: Play tracks one after another
play_tracks.description: For players without a queue (e.g. WiiM): plays the tracks in order, repeating by the repeat rounds; stops when something else starts playing.

tracks.name: Tracks
tracks.description: List of media-source IDs or URLs, in order.

start.name: Start at
start.description: Index of the first track (0 = first).

stop_tracks.name: Stop track sequence
stop_tracks.description: Stops the track sequence started by “Play tracks one after another”.

sleep_timer.name: Sleep timer
sleep_timer.description: Stops the player after the given minutes (fading out during the last 30 seconds). Sonos uses its own timer. 0 clears the timer.

move_queue_item.name: Move track in queue
move_queue_item.description: Moves a track within the Sonos queue (positions start at 0).

set_order.name: Reorder track sequence
set_order.description: New order for the running “Play tracks one after another” sequence; it continues after the current track.

tracks.name: Tracks
tracks.description: The same tracks in the new order.

add_tracks.name: Add tracks to sequence
add_tracks.description: Appends tracks to the running “Play tracks one after another” sequence.
